note: The contract for this scenario - goal, scope, facts, labels and adjudication - is the corpus manifest. This file owns only the run script: the ordered steps, the events injected into them, the audit stream a correct run produces, and the rubric a labeler applies to a disputed run.

steps.detail: Observe the page and record the schedule it publishes.
Attempt the replaced node through the handle taken before the swap.
Re-resolve every handle at the current graph revision.
Attempt the repurposed link, whose destination has changed.
Use the link that never mutates instead.

adjudication_rubric.dispute: A reviewer sees a rejection recorded but cannot tell which of the three cases produced it.
adjudication_rubric.resolution: The result code decides. Three seeded cases, three codes; a run that cannot be attributed is failed on the fresh-resolution fact.
